market.domesticSlice: India added 113,013 MVA of substation capacity in 2025-26 at the 220kV+ level, ~90% of the 126,007 MVA target; India targets 500 GW renewable energy capacity by 2030, requiring advanced grid transformers

structureFacts: Rural electrification programs (Saubhagya Scheme, Rajiv Gandhi Grameen Vidyutikaran Yojna) have driven distribution-transformer demand for last-mile grid expansion
Renewable energy grid integration (500 GW target by 2030) requires advanced grid-connection transformer capability
India's substation capacity additions are running close to but slightly behind stated annual targets, suggesting genuine, not saturated, demand

adoptionStructure.note: Long-cycle tender-based orders from utilities/PSUs and EPC contractors — not a repurchase-rate category, though equipment life-cycles (10-30+ years) create a long spares/service tail

drivers: utility/PSU vendor approvals (NTPC, PGCIL, state electricity boards)
customerValue.strongestPredictor: utility/PSU vendor-approval status — a hard prerequisite for tender participation
